summary: v10.2.18 — Validated server-side cache (60s) for /api/dashboard/batch, /api/asi/leaderboard & /live, cache-key separation (profile/markets), v10.2.17 BUY-gates regression, and frontend EXECUTE wiring (copy-trade removes AsiTradeSheet, calls executeTrade + navigates). Backend 7/8 passed (/health 1 failure is EXPECTED — K8s ingress only routes /api/* to backend, /health hits the Expo web). Frontend copy-trade shows 25 copy-execute-{rank} buttons, no AsiTradeSheet/preview opens on tap (code paths & live DOM both confirm). Dynamic (a)/(b) scenarios could not be exercised because the live leaderboard in test env has 25 CLOSED rows only (no OPEN row → EXECUTE disabled). Watchdog + Retry (ats-preview-retry) and i18n keys verified via code review; dependency on previewAttempt confirms retry restart.

minor.issue: Not reachable from public URL — ingress only forwards /api/*. Backend defines it for internal K8s probe; tests must hit /api/ instead.

integration_issues.issue: Could not exercise (a) no-bot Alert and (b) executeTrade→router.push dynamically because /leaderboard/live returned 25 CLOSED entries only (EXECUTE disabled for closed rows). Code paths (lines 42-128) correctly implement spec: getBot gate, Alert w/ CTA to /asi-bot, api.asi.executeTrade with bot params, router.push('/trades-position'). Main agent can self-verify by seeding one OPEN asi_trade in Mongo and retrying.

action_items: No action needed on backend cache or copy-trade handler — all server behaviour and testID wiring verified.

Optional: to live-test flow (a)/(b) end-to-end, main agent can seed an OPEN row in asi_trades for test-judge-device-001 (or any device_id) so copy-trade shows an enabled EXECUTE; backend changes NOT required.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /dashboard/batch cache (_BATCH_CACHE) correctly keys on markets+timeframe+sort+full+min_conf+min_wr+region+profile+extras and includes _boundary — invalidates on new candle. TTL 60s. In-flight dedupe implemented via _BATCH_INFLIGHT.
asi_bot/routes.py leaderboard & live cache (_lb_cache) TTL 60s + inflight dedupe; both call leaderboard/live_leaderboard with limit=25 enforcing items<=25.

copy-trade.tsx: AsiTradeSheet NOT rendered (only `formulaTagFromSignal` imported). onExecuteCopy: getBot → if !exists Alert w/ ASI-Bot CTA; else api.asi.executeTrade with bot's risk/leverage/tp/margin/entry_mode/active_testnet, then router.push('/trades-position'). Correct.

AsiTradeSheet.tsx: 5000ms watchdog in effect (line 184) sets previewTimeout=true if not cancelled; error with code/detail still overrides preview via setPreview() path (lines 210-216); error without code (network drop) hits setPreviewTimeout(true) branch. retryPreview increments previewAttempt and that value is in effect dependency array → re-runs preview. testID='ats-preview-retry' present.
